answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 11440 Country: India Title: Assalamualaikum , Can a Girl Marry her Mother's Uncle's son. Means apni Ammi ke Chacha ke bete se kya nikah Jayaz Hai.Jabki wo ladka us ladki ka MAMA lagta hai. Question: Assalamualaikum , Can a Girl Marry her Mother's Uncle's son. Means apni Ammi ke Chacha ke bete se kya nikah Jayaz Hai.Jabki wo ladka us ladki ka MAMA lagta hai. Answer ID: 11440 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 505/375=L/1430) The boy is not the real mamun (maternal uncle) of the girl, therefore they can marry. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
